import json, sys
import mod.server.extraServerApi as api
factory = api.GetEngineCompFactory()
player = api.GetPlayerList()[0]
info, items = factory.CreateBlockInfo(player), factory.CreateItem(player)
saved = sys._shield_banner_frame_r20
rows = []
for row in reversed(saved['journal']):
    assert row['block']['name'] == 'minecraft:air' and not row['nbt']
    info.SetBlockNew(row['pos'], row['block'], 0, 0, True, True)
    actual = info.GetBlockNew(row['pos'], 0)
    assert actual == row['block']
    assert not info.GetBlockEntityData(0, row['pos'])
    rows.append({'pos': row['pos'], 'actual': actual})
inventory_type = api.GetMinecraftEnum().ItemPosType.INVENTORY
assert items.GetPlayerItem(inventory_type, 35, True) == saved['inventory']
del sys._shield_banner_frame_r20
_result = json.dumps({'restored_cells': rows, 'inventory_unchanged': True, 'global_removed': True})
